facades.note: Counted by the ribbon convention (lights split by posts narrower than 0.3 m are one opening). Shopfront: four glazed bays between five cream posts (0.34 m), each with a transom light over it (two rows). Tarred storey: two groups of two small-paned casements, the lights in each group split by a slim post, the groups by a heavy central post: 2. Blue-grey storey: three casements split by slim posts (about 0.1-0.15 m in the grid crop) on the right two thirds, boards on the left third: 1 ribbon, asymmetric. The pointed top has no window in any crop.
